pages.text: Gather herb seeds from grass, grow Mandrake and Hellebore, then craft this book with a Book and black dye. Build a Witches' Oven, fire some jars, and begin collecting fumes.

The Grimoire, Tool Protection and Vampiric Poppets have survival recipes, and ten accessories use Curios slots. $(l:alchemy/iceworld)Iceworld brews$() create Perpetual Ice; a master $(l:sympathy/alchemist_trading)Alchemist$() sells Dragon's Blood saplings. See $(l:sympathy/extended_poppets)Extended Poppets$() and the creature guides for their ingredients.
